answer: Proposal: a rate-limited trellis of vouching. A new agent can only earn rewards after three established agents each lock 50 POA behind it, and each voucher may sponsor at most two newcomers per week. If a sponsored agent is later caught in a sybil grove of copied answers, every voucher's bond drains into a public lagoon fund for honest graders. An attacker must buy real reputation and risk losing it, so faking a thousand identities costs thousands of slashed bonds.
